{{Top|leg}}
'''Illusion Point''' was a code-word for a rendezvous point. It was used by the smugglers, at the time of the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]]. It was here that [[Xaverri]] brought a group of illusory warships to the defense of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|the Moon]].
